seen.extent: Antonio de Guaras, London, 14 June 1574: f. 108r-v clear Spanish; ff. 109r-110r 59 lines of cipher with no word division (31 + 28 lines). All 59 lines transcribed in two blind passes; 20 lines drawn at random transcribed again by two further blind readers. Lettenhove's footnote read in full on the page images.
seen.cipher: One-to-one letter substitution in 21 signs (lower-case letters and the figures 6 and 8), commas and dots, two raised abbreviation marks; nothing written between the lines. Lettenhove prints the whole ciphered passage in plain Spanish, from 'Al Quiligre[u] he despues entendido' (p. 177) to 'Dios le de esfuerço y prospero sucesso!' (p. 178), with the source note '(Record office, Cal., n° 1452.)' on p. 178.

prior_art.edition: Printed in plain Spanish, ciphered passage included: Kervyn de Lettenhove, Relations politiques des Pays-Bas et de l'Angleterre sous le règne de Philippe II, vol. VII (Brussels 1888), pp. 176-178, footnote to no. MMDCCLVI (Sweveghem to Requesens, London, 14 June 1574): 'Antonio de Guaras adressait de Londres, le 14 juin 1574, la lettre suivante à don Pedro Menendez'. Source note on p. 178: '(Record office, Cal., n° 1452.)', i.e. CSP Foreign 1572-74 no. 1452, p. 514 ('A considerable portion not deciphered'). The Spanish calendar (Hume, vol. 2) does not print this letter.
prior_art.literature: In this repository: SOLVED_CATALOGUE.md section 4 already lists the letter as catalogue 303, 'Antonio de Guaras, London (TNA SP 70 (CSP Foreign x no. 1452); catalogue 303): Read in part at the time (checked 22 Sept 2026)'. CSP Scotland (Thorpe) vol. 1 pp. 383-384 has Killigrew's mission to the Regent in May-June 1574, without naming the matter.

1001.key_check: Key rebuilt from the ciphertext and matched to Lettenhove's text (1001/key.json): seven reciprocal neighbour swaps d/e f/g h/i m/n o/p q/r s/t; z=a, c=b, 6=c, k=l, x=u, 8=t forced by the text; l=y not forced (the sign occurs only in an abbreviation ending). On 20 random lines transcribed blind, a letter-trigram test without word division put the key above all 1,000 permuted tables (-2.194 per letter against a best of -3.339); a word-share test missed (31.6% against a mark of 65%).

1001.closed: Duplicate of catalogue 303 (SOLVED_CATALOGUE.md section 4, Antonio de Guaras, London, CSP Foreign x no. 1452). The ciphered passage is also in print in plain Spanish: Kervyn de Lettenhove, Relations politiques vol. VII (1888) pp. 176-178, footnote to no. MMDCCLVI, from this Record Office letter (no. 1452). The key rebuilt here reproduces his text on the sample lines; no new reading is claimed.
